# DUM-SDK 0.15.0

## Protocol and runtime

- Upgrade the wire protocol to 6 for bounded runtime module-failure reports. Paper revokes the player's grants, logs the report, fires `ClientModuleFailureEvent` and disconnects for rejoin. This applies to optional and required managed play callbacks; client effects stop immediately, with a connection-bound local disconnect fallback if Paper does not respond.
- Let server-scoped Fabric mods publish named/versioned EventFactory hooks for hot modules. Declared hook contracts and provider dependencies are validated before consumer startup, hot/cold dependencies resolve together, subscriptions are guarded by both contexts and old listeners are removed on unload. Native mixins/interfaces load once per game; existing hooks can serve new hot consumers after a server rejoin.
- Clean runtime failure report lines with the same control-character rules the codec validates, so C1 controls in exception text do not prevent the report from reaching Paper.

## Paper plugin

- Add `/dumsdk reload <id> [id ...]` to publish only selected staged modules/Fabric mods while preserving the other published jars. Jars are validated and copied off the game thread, publication attempts are serialized, the previous catalog stays on failure and all online players are disconnected after success. The no-argument reload still publishes the entire staging folder.
- Keep Paper closed instead of disabling DUM-SDK when its messages or published catalog cannot be loaded at startup. Every join gets the Russian `core.unavailable` text until `/dumsdk reload` publishes a valid catalog; previously a disabled plugin let players in without the client mod.
- Ignore `handshake.enabled: false` with a startup warning: it disconnected every player on join. The handshake is always on.
- After a plugin reload without a server restart (plugman), restore module access of online players that use the `dum:sdk` channel from the persistent published catalog. The old instance clears its grants; reload plugins that use `DumSdkApi` together with DUM-SDK.
- Disconnect a player for a malformed play-phase `dum:sdk` message (`runtime.malformed`, `MALFORMED_MESSAGE`) and reject unexpected configuration messages, logging one line per connection instead of one per message.
- Warn the publishing administrator (`core.publish-rollback`) when a module gets a lower semantic version than the previously published one: clients that installed the newer version refuse it with `VERSION_ROLLBACK`.
- Drop handshake state of connections that closed before Paper's configure event.

## DUM-SDK menu

- Add the DUM-SDK menu to the main Settings button group with Overview, Updates, Errors and Files tabs; `/sdk` opens the same screen. It shows module timings, server/session state, SDK/protocol/runtime versions, memory use, updater state and pending restarts. The button follows the normal Settings grid order.
- Keep a bounded local error history across restarts, including updater, installation, disconnect and module failures. Add crash-report/JVM fatal report discovery, previews, copyable summaries and file/folder actions for client logs, reports and the cold-install helper.
- Browse published release descriptions inside Updates with pagination, fixed-repository tag links and cached offline reading. Release-history loading is separate from signed executable updates.
- Show searchable Modifications only for an accepted SDK server, plus a pause-menu shortcut. Each module and server Fabric mod of the current catalog gets its own card with version, authors, description, dependencies, activity, validation status and timings; click/Enter opens copyable details. Local Fabric mods and other servers' cached mods are excluded.
- Accept optional module `name`, `description` and string-array `authors` metadata without changing the module API version. Older jars remain supported.

## Updates and disconnect screens

- Show Russian update progress, retries and terminal error notifications. Temporary network/HTTP errors get up to three attempts with 5/15 second pauses; invalid metadata/signatures are rejected without retry. After a failure, the menu offers a manual GitHub download and an on-demand check.
- Add a Russian "Go to GitHub" button on disconnect screens linking to the fixed SDK release page through Minecraft's link confirmation.
- Separate the outdated-client restart instructions and stable error code into paragraphs.

## Upgrade and validation

Update both the client and Paper plugin together: protocol 6 is incompatible with protocol 5 in SDK 0.14.2. Clients with the self-updating 0.14.x mod are told to restart the game and update on the next start. Existing `config.yml` and `messages.yml` keep working: new message keys fall back to the bundled Russian texts, and `handshake.enabled` is ignored. Overrides of `handshake.outdated-client` and `handshake.error-code` keep their old spacing until updated. Plugins that use `DumSdkApi` must be restarted or reloaded together with DUM-SDK.

Local macOS verification passed: 66 unit tests, real client/Paper integration runs for runtime failure reports, named hooks, selective publication, the SDK menu and updater retries, and a raw-protocol Paper probe for the fail-closed startup and malformed message limits. Windows/Linux clients, the players' full modpack with Sodium/Iris, plugman reloads and the live VDS remain unchecked.
